Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1154
Claimant:
Lori Greene
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
2024-06-11
Claim received for a side impact at an intersection involving our insured's vehicle and a second vehicle, with a wrist
fracture reported by the claimant. Claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the
attorney's office. Verified that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was active at the time of loss.
2024-08-06
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of the collision. Two witnesses are
listed on the report, though neither was present at the scene in a way that could independently confirm the sequence
of events. Requested photos from the insured and the claimant.
2024-08-19
Photos received and reviewed. They confirm several details of the collision, including the points of contact on both
vehicles. Damage to the vehicle is consistent with the impact as described. No prior damage to the vehicle is known
from our records or the insured's account, and nothing suggests the damage predates the coverage start date.
2024-08-23
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who provided the initial medical records. The claimant's account of the collision
was consistent with what was given during the first recorded statement. Wrist fracture is consistent in type and force
with the reported impact.
2024-10-23
Reviewed the orthopedic records. Treatment followed a typical course, including immobilization, follow-up imaging,
and physical therapy, with the frequency of visits tapering as the claimant improved. Records also show prior
tretament for the same wrist within the last two years, and that earlier condition is noted as contributing to some of the
current complaints.
2024-11-25
Requested prior records for the earlier wrist condition to separate it from the current injury. Claimant's attorney has
been asked to provide them. Follow-up call scheduled with counsel to discuss timing.
2024-11-30
Follow-up call with counsel completed. The claimant's account remains the same in every conversation to date, with
no material differences in sequence or description. Prior records received and under review for how they affect the
current treatment plan.
2024-12-17
Medical review notes that the current treatment and recovery timeline are reasonable given the injury, with the prior
condition likely adding to the overall complaints. No independent witness has come forward to add to the account
beyond the police report.
2025-01-09
File remains open pneding final medical summary and the attorney's demand package. Next action is to review the
demand once received and reassess the injury evaluation against the complete records.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
